title: Developer Connector Workflow Validation
objective: Menguji certified developer connectors sesuai scopes, organizations/workspaces, rate limits, revoke, and audit.

resource_access.reason: 115.28 names the same guarantee with a different word. The alias is recorded here rather than applied silently, so a reader can see that the canonical 117.17 wording is not a word-for-word match to any anchor.

unmapped_acceptance.rate_limits: No anchor source declares a rate-limit acceptance item. The RATE_LIMITED health state is declared in 115.10's health_states vocabulary and is exercised here, but no canonical source promises rate-limit behaviour for developer connectors, so this check is drilled and reported rather than counted as a satisfied acceptance.

boundary: Local, manifest-driven developer connector metadata, connection health, and audit only. Live OAuth, repository access, organization policy, rate-limit windows, credentials, certified provider availability, hosted CI, signing, telemetry, hardware, adoption, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
limitations: This manifest validates local contracts and shipped domain behaviour. It does not execute a live provider request.
No developer connector is CERTIFIED in the provider registry; the drills use locally constructed manifests, never the production availability claim.
